sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas

policies.title: Philippine ordinary passports: Paraguay short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Paraguay's January 2026 migration schedule states that Philippine ordinary-passport holders do not require a visa for stays up to 30 days.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Philippine passport for a visitor stay of no more than 30 days under Paraguay's cited unilateral exemption.
Work, residence, study, special passports, other purposes and final admission remain outside this short-visitor classification.

policies.title: Philippine ordinary passports: Panama advance stamped visa
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy guidance lists the Philippines among nationalities requiring a stamped visa rather than in its visa-exempt list.
conditions: An ordinary Philippine-passport visitor must obtain the applicable stamped visa before travel unless a separately documented conditional exception applies.
Conditional routes based on a qualifying third-country visa or residence permit are deliberately excluded from this ordinary-passport baseline.

policies.title: Philippine ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visa baseline
policies.summary: Türkiye's current MFA guidance requires ordinary Philippine-passport holders to have a visa; eVisa eligibility depends on an additional qualifying Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland visa or residence permit.
conditions: This is the unconditional ordinary-passport baseline for a short visit; obtain the appropriate visa before travel.

The conditional eVisa route requiring a valid Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland visa or residence permit is excluded from the normalized baseline. Diplomatic, official and service-passport exemptions are also excluded.

policies.title: Philippine ordinary passports: Grenada advance visa
policies.summary: Grenada's April 2024 official Embassy schedule assigns the Philippines to Prior to Arrival, defined as obtaining a visa from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: An ordinary Philippine-passport visitor must obtain the visa from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, residence, transit, special passports, other purposes and final admission remain outside this ordinary short-visitor classification.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's MFA says Philippine ordinary-passport holders require a visa and limits eVisa access to travellers who also hold a qualifying third-country visa or residence permit; the project excludes that conditional route from the baseline.
